I read quite a bit. This is an arbitrary subset of some of the best works I've come across.

## Nonfiction

::: {.reading-list}
- [The Autobiography of Benjamin Franklin]{.book} [by Benjamin Franklin]{.by}
- [Deep Work]{.book} [by Cal Newport]{.by}
- [Four Thousand Weeks]{.book} [by Oliver Burkeman]{.by}
- [The Lessons of History]{.book} [by Will and Ariel Durant]{.by}
- [Principles]{.book} [by Ray Dalio]{.by}
- [The War of Art]{.book} [by Steven Pressfield]{.by}
:::
